newsitem.title: GREECE: Inflows continue, fx forwards dip in Greek trade.
newsitem.headline: Inflows continue, fx forwards dip in Greek trade.

text.p: About 160 million ecus were sold for drachmas at the fixing on the second consecutive day of forex inflows and ecu/drachma was trading easier at 300.95 from the fixing's 301.03, forex dealers said.
Depo rates were coming off earlier peaks to touch Monday afternoon levels in late dealing and forex forwards were five to 10 basis points softer across the board, money dealers said.
"Depos firmed earlier on but were correcting in late trade coming down to Monday afternoon levels," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
The central bank kept its overnight intervention bid unchanged at 12.40 percent.
The mark was quoted at 158.10/15 drachmas from Tuesday's 158.130 fix, the dollar at 239.25/35 drachmas from 239.190 and the Ecu at 300.89/99 from 301.030 drachmas.
